newsitem.title: UK: Brit Biotech says sales team could reach 500.
newsitem.headline: Brit Biotech says sales team could reach 500.

text.p: British Biotech Plc said on Wednesday that its international sales force could eventually grow to 500 following the successful launch of its leading products for cancer and pancreatitis.

In a presentation to the Lehman Brothers European healthcare conference, chief executive officer Keith McCullagh said acute pancreatitis drug Zacutex would allow the group to build its European marketing force and "get it ready for the Marimastat launch two to 2-1/2 years later."

British Biotech is due to present Phase III trial data on Zacutex at the "Digestive Disease Week" conference in Washington on May 12. McCullagh said Zacutex, which should be the group's first marketed product, was "on target for launch in the first half of 1998."
